description_en: Queries the health check configuration (Layer 4 or Layer 7) of port forwarding rules
description_zh: 查询端口转发规则的健康检查配置（四层或七层）
name: DescribeHealthCheckList

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The JSON string of the Listeners array to query. Each Listener has the following structure:

InstanceId, String, required. The instance ID.
Protocol, String, required. The protocol type.
FrontendPort, Integer, required. The frontend port. Valid values: 0 to 65535.
BackendPort, Integer, optional. The backend port. Valid values: 0 to 65535.
RealServers, JSON array, optional. The IP addresses of the origin server.
IsAutoCreate, Boolean, optional. Specifies whether automatic creation is used. If yes, the rule cannot be deleted or modified
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的Listeners数组JSON串，每个Listener的具体结构描述如下：

InstanceId，String类型，必选，实例ID。
Protocol，String类型，必选，协议类型。
FrontendPort，Integer类型，必选，前端使用的端口，取值范围：0-65535。
BackendPort，Integer类型，可选，后端使用的端口，取值范围：0-65535。
RealServers，Json数组类型，可选，源站IP地址。
IsAutoCreate，Boolean类型，可选，是否自动创建。如果是，则不允许删除和修改
parameters.name: listeners

Domain.description_en: The domain name for the Layer 7 Health Check
Domain.description_zh: 健康检查/七层健康检查/域名

Down.description_en: The Unhealthy Threshold for the Layer 4 Health Check
Down.description_zh: 健康检查/四层健康检查/不健康阈值

Interval.description_en: The Health Check Interval for the Layer 4 Health Check
Interval.description_zh: 健康检查/四层健康检查/检查间隔

Port.description_en: The Health Check Port for the Layer 4 Health Check
Port.description_zh: 健康检查/四层健康检查/检查端口

Timeout.description_en: The Response Timeout Period for the Layer 4 Health Check
Timeout.description_zh: 健康检查/四层健康检查/响应超时时间

Type.description_en:
The protocol type. Valid values:

TCP: Layer 4
HTTP: Layer 7
Type.description_zh:
协议类型，取值：

TCP：四层
HTTP：七层

Up.description_en: The Healthy Threshold for the Layer 4 Health Check
Up.description_zh: 健康检查/四层健康检查/健康阈值

Uri.description_en: The Health Check Path for the Layer 7 Health Check
Uri.description_zh: 健康检查/七层健康检查/检查路径

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro instance
